hero.title: Backend-focused developer building software around real application problems.
hero.description: I work primarily with C#/.NET and Python, with the strongest technical depth in backend systems, APIs, application logic and automation.

story.title: Backend first, with a broader view of the product
paragraphs: My development background started with C# and .NET, which remain the technologies where I have the strongest technical depth. I enjoy designing backend logic, APIs, permissions, data flows and the systems that sit behind an application.

Over time, I expanded into Python for automation and integration. Projects such as Price Watch have given me practical experience connecting .NET applications with Python processes, browser automation and external workflows.

When a project requires a complete product, I also work with React, TypeScript, databases and deployment. My longer-term direction is to combine that application experience with backend engineering to build practical software that uses AI as part of real product workflows.

items.title: Backend Design
items.description: I think carefully about API responsibilities, business logic, authentication, authorization and how data moves through an application.

items.title: Integration & Automation
items.description: I like connecting services and tools into practical workflows, including .NET applications, Python automation and external integrations.

items.title: Product Thinking
items.description: I prefer solving the actual application problem rather than treating each technical layer as an isolated implementation task.

items.title: End-to-End Delivery
items.description: When needed, I work across UI, data, configuration and deployment so the core backend becomes a complete usable application.

skills.title: Core expertise and application delivery
skills.description: My strongest technical depth is in backend development, supported by the tools I use for automation, integration and complete application delivery.

cta.title: Looking for a backend developer who can think beyond the API?
cta.description: I'm open to projects and opportunities involving backend systems, APIs, automation and practical AI-enabled software.
